entries.hypothesis: A learned public-information controller deciding WHEN to delegate to the supplied dep_reuse sub-policy (until next commit) improves deployed utility over D and adds value beyond simple rules.
entries.intervention: learned delegation controller: at each public decision point in a registered trigger set (D anchor in {call, reuse_recompute, commit_revise}), estimate Q-hat(delegate) - Q-hat(D) from public features (model family fixed before evaluation: per-anchor ridge as in A-HR2 G1b, plus optionally a small MLP; chosen on development worlds); delegate if gain > margin m (registered on development worlds); multiple delegations per episode allowed; delegation ends at next successful commit or 12 steps

comparators: always-teacher: dep_reuse for the whole episode
simple rule R1: delegate at every call anchor
simple rule R2: delegate at every commit_revise anchor
random delegation at the learned controller's matched rate
A3-style teacher-action supervision comparator is superseded: the teacher itself is included
endpoints: regret of delegation decisions (branch-evaluated on a subsample)
